question: finite-dim Out trivial (Skolem-Noether)? transpose automorphism or anti?
conclusion: Aut(M_n)=Inn(M_n), Out trivial. Transpose is anti-automorphism on noncommutative M_n, becomes identity (automorphism) after abelianization. Diff(M) is automorphism of abelianized C^inf(M), not of noncommutative R. Outer automorphisms / diffeomorphisms only emerge at n->infinity (discrete -> continuous).
